It sure can feel harrowing waiting on such a big bucket of excitement, but like most, I’m aware that it will happen. Our situation is odd with this, too, as a friend of ours with a much higher backer number wouldn’t be available at his home during one of the estimated delivery updates so changed his address to ours. None of us thought to change it back after that original estimate fell through and now his pledge is shipping out to us while ours is seemingly coming in later. Mysteries, the lot of it.

 

The whole thing is silly, but we will be hauling that beautiful carton to him and playing a bit that weekend, so not even a huge loss! Hopefully the bit of experimentation with OblivAeon content can hold us over for the extra however many weeks and not just cause my brain to explode in anticipation!
